capture.privacy: Prototype only: the image stays in this browser tab and is never sent to a service. Only reviewed transaction fields are saved; the image preview is discarded when you leave this screen.

owed.title: Who owes what
owed.description: Keep incoming payments and outgoing obligations distinct.
owed.assumptionsExcluded: These assumptions are not included in outstanding totals.

schedules.title: Plan the next payment
schedules.description: One-time and monthly payments, with a shared lifecycle.
schedules.addHelp: Future payments stay scheduled. When due, the demo records an unconfirmed assumption for you to review. Monthly schedules catch up missed months and show a rolling one-year forecast.
schedules.forecastHelp: Monthly schedules show past occurrences and a rolling one-year forecast. Forecasts do not count in cash totals.
schedules.saveError: This schedule could not be saved. Check the details and try again.
schedules.confirmUnpaid: Mark this payment as unpaid? Its cash movement will be removed and the obligation restored.
